title: Algerian Tagine
description: A traditional Algerian stew made with aromatic spices and slow-cooked meat. This recipe serves 4-6 people.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tbsp of algerian over medium heat.
Add 1 tsp of yeasty and cook for 1 minute.
Add 2 large dish and cook for 2-3 minutes per side.
Add 1 whole tagine and cook for 5 minutes.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise for 2 hours.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
